architecture.product_shape: hybrid row-based recommender, not one universal ranked list
pipeline: candidate generators: collaborative/product hybrid, metadata, graph relations, people/staff/studios, popularity/current season
hard filters: known titles, explicit defaults, low-value recaps/shorts, unmet prerequisites
cross-row deduplication and light diversity caps
global_hard_filters: remove already known titles outside continuation context
exclude hentai/explicit entries unless the profile indicates they are wanted
avoid low-value recaps, manner movies, tiny shorts, and summary-only entries
block sequels/specials with unmet prerequisites outside continue_your_journey

general_row_mix.remaining_slots: learned guarded hybrid profile matches, with content fallback

row_policy.negative_feedback: Low scores and dropped entries reduce content, similar-title, people/staff, and exploration scores.
row_policy.sequencing_guardrail: Rows other than continue_your_journey block titles with unmet Prequel, Parent Story, or Full Story prerequisites.
row_policy.weak_relation_guardrail: Other and Alternative Setting relations only feed continue_your_journey when title tokens suggest the same franchise.
row_policy.diversity_guardrail: Rows cap repeated primary genres and repeated anchors so one franchise/person cannot fill the whole row.
row_policy.cross_row_guardrail: A title can appear in only one row; earlier rows claim it first.
row_policy.exploration_guardrail: give_it_a_try avoids recaps, summary movies, tiny shorts, low-audience score spikes, and direct continuation entries.
